intro: This page lists what the site collects and what it does not. It sets no cookies.

items.text: After launch, cookieless analytics counts page views. It uses no cookies and no fingerprinting.
Text you paste into the fit check is processed in your browser and never leaves it.
The site collects no personal data about visitors.
There are no advertising or marketing scripts and no third-party trackers.
